Le gouvernement entend ramener le déficit à 5 % du PIB en 2027, grâce à un effort de redressement de 54 milliards d'euros, dont 43 milliards via des mesures nouvelles. Alors qu'il était déjà censé baisser en 2026, le déficit public devrait repartir à la hausse, selon les estimations du ministère de l’Économie et des Finances, passant de 5,1 % du PIB en 2025 à 5,4 % cette année. excerpt: # French presidential race largely unaffected by unrest, first post-riot poll shows – POLITICO [Skip to main content](https://www.politico.eu/article/first-post-riot-poll-shows-stable-french-presidential-voting-intentions/#main) PARIS — The first publicly available poll following the violence that rocked France over the weekend showed little change in voter intentions in next spring’s presidential election. While even some of far-right front-runner Marine Le Pen’s adversaries [expected her to get a boost](https://www.politico.eu/article/french-riots-lay-bare-risks-and-opportunities-for-2027-election-candidates/) from the rioting and looting that took place on the sidelines of peaceful protests on Saturday, the survey published by Ifop and Fiducial found little change in her support levels. Nor was there much change in voting intentions toward far-left candidate Jean-Luc Mélenchon, whom the government has repeatedly blamed for stoking the violence. Mélenchon and his allies have repeatedly and forcefully denied the accusation. The poll was conducted online from 8 p.m. Saturday — after rioting and looting had begun — until Monday.
